waivers.cream-palette: docs/design/brief.md §4 pins the grounds: Gilded Hour is white Carrara marble (#F8F6F1), Conservatory is creme herbarium paper (#F4EEDF). The brief wins over the saturated-pattern warning (impeccable SKILL.md: 'The brief wins').
waivers.src/themes/*/fonts.css: Metric-matched fallback faces ('Cinzel Fallback' etc.) are @font-face names for local() fallbacks, not DESIGN.md families; stylelint still bans the anti-reference fonts there.
waivers.playwright-report/**: Generated Playwright HTML report (gitignored). Its inlined Ubuntu/Droid Sans Mono/Helvetica and grey literals are the reporter's own chrome, not this site's design system.
waivers.kicker-above-heading: The approved Botanical–Deco pages (Sara and Tyler's sign-off) set a short tracked label above each title; kept only where the approved images have one. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.all-caps-body: The approved Botanical–Deco date, place and page subtitles are single tracked-caps lines at the 17px control-caps step, never paragraphs. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.italic-serif-display: The approved Explore page sets 'Chicago' as one italic Bodoni display word (REF-EXPLORE); it is the only italic display on the site. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
waivers.hero-eyebrow-chip: REF-EXPLORE sets 'SARA + TYLER' in tracked capitals above the page title; the companion page heads keep that one line and nothing else above their H1. docs/design/approved-botanical-deco/detector-waivers.md.
